title: Blood Supply Depends On Just 3% Of Eligible Donors
hook: Just 3% of eligible people donate blood each year.
closing: Hospitals need more eligible people to become repeat donors before shortages deepen.
question: Would you become a regular donor?

segments.say: Only 3% of eligible people donate blood, leaving hospitals dependent on a tiny volunteer pool.
Donor volume fell to an index of 60, shrinking the pool hospitals already rely on.
